prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept architectural elevation. Transform the supplied approved artbook concept sheet into ONE standalone isolated render of ONLY its named building, matching its detailed stylized 3D material craft, geometry, roof silhouette, storey count, wall finish, trim, fixtures and curated wear. The artbook is DESIGN REFERENCE, NOT a page to reproduce. NO layout, NO collaged views, NO labels/captions/dimension arrows, NO title/footer, NO annotation colors, NO paper or drawn checkerboard. Transparent background with genuine clean alpha; no white rectangle, sky, street, water, quay, neighboring buildings, ground shadow or large diorama platform. Only a very thin continuous foundation directly under the building may remain; remove detached dock bollards, freestanding street lamps, characters, loose foreground clutter and sea base. Preserve attached fixtures and restrained reference planters. Show one complete building centered with at least 12% clear margin around all extremities, no cropping. Warm lit AFTER/restored presentation, neutral even studio lighting, mild weathering, no redesign. Camera is LEVEL at facade mid-height, strictly ORTHOGRAPHIC ELEVATION, not perspective, not isometric, not three-quarter, no downward tilt. Verticals parallel, facade horizontal lines level, no roof-top surface visible from an elevated camera. Do not reveal an adjacent wall face except tiny edge thickness. Each file is one projection of the SAME building. Colors: faded teal, warm cream, walnut, brick, dusty coral, amber lamps. Any existing shop sign may remain as part of the actual building, but no explanatory text outside it. Render clean detailed high-quality isolated game-asset concept, not a simplified blockout.
REFERENCES: Image 1 is the just-generated FRONT identity anchor of this exact building; image 2 is its approved ARTBOOK sheet for other wall/roof details. Rotate the SAME architectural asset, do not redesign or merely edit the front into another front. Keep material colors, weathering scale, floor count and vertical dimensions consistent with image 1. Do not copy the opaque-looking RGB matte behind the reference: the new export must have clean genuine transparent alpha outside silhouette. Avoid glow/haze/vignette outside asset.
BUILDING: NQ-BLD-13 / Dockline Depot. Dockline Depot: brick lower half and teal corrugated metal upper warehouse, GABLED/low pitched roof, central large walnut cross-braced double loading doors on front, overhead wood beam and side-mounted jib hoist at front LEFT, hanging hook, small personnel door on front RIGHT with shallow metal rain hood. RIGHT side has TWO small amber rectangular windows aligned at different heights, pipes, brick plinth. Back keeps same gable pitch with quieter loading/utility treatment, no duplicated front jib. Modest roof vent/skylight.
REQUESTED VIEW: LEFT SIDE ELEVATION ONLY. Camera at building -X looking exactly +X. This is the opposite side from the RIGHT/+X elevation usually drawn on the artbook sheet. The FRONT end of this side is at image RIGHT; the REAR end at image LEFT. Render the actual left wall, not a horizontally mirrored front or mirrored right wall. No front storefront face should be visible. Carry over cream bands, masonry and same roof edge; plausible quieter service-side details only where absent in source. Preserve front-only signage/awning as edge-on at image right, never move them onto this side wall.
Projection: strict LEVEL ORTHOGRAPHIC elevation, camera normal to the requested wall, zero yaw error, no camera pitch. Show only requested facade. Render only one object/view. Use same object vertical scale and base alignment as the front identity image as closely as possible. Keep all building/antenna/chimney extents uncropped with transparent margin.
unseen_details: Interpreted consistently from artbook; no measured mesh reconstruction claimed
